cost_of_full_eq_plus: type tracking for all shapes, or declared string types (a type-system change)
binop dispatch (call the vartani_tul loop for ==, alloc+copy for +)
NUL-vs-(pointer,length) disambiguation: require NUL-termination for all 'strings' (breaks the slice idiom) or carry lengths (a representation change)
ws1_choice_vs_constraint.for_concat_plus: CONSTRAINT: concatenation for variables cannot be done honestly with current machinery — needs a result buffer (persistent arena = leak, scratch = dangle; vartani_cat itself does not allocate and has no capacity guard), capacity (lengths via NUL scans O(n+m) or stored lengths, which do not exist), dispatch, and the NUL assumption
ws1_choice_vs_constraint.for_eq: CHOICE for tracked shapes (literals, tracked locals) within a CONSTRAINT for the general case: content comparison exists (vartani_tul, O(n) NUL-scan) and could be wired into == for tracked shapes, but not for all shapes (parameters, globals, kosh elements, call results untracked; pointers carry no runtime tag), so a general == cannot tell a string from an address; I chose consistency over a partial ==
ws1_choice_vs_constraint.reference_sentence: A string is a bare pointer with no length. == and + on string variables compare and add addresses; they do not compare or concatenate contents. For contents, use vartani_tul (returns 0 if equal) and vartani_cat (writes into the caller's buffer, which must already be large enough, and does not allocate) — and only on NUL-terminated strings, never on slices. Literal-involved + is concatenated at compile time, which is why those forms work.

representation.convention_a_nul_terminated: literals (lexer pool stores terminators); vartani_cat results (terminator copied); shabda, vartani_tul, vartani_aayam are all byte-scan loops stopping at NUL
representation.convention_b_pointer_length: the khand world takes (ptr, n) pairs; the slice idiom is a pointer plus an explicit length elsewhere (r79 report_blocks:188 likha(1, letters + offset, 1))
representation.fold_rule: fold_const folds + at compile time when a literal is involved: literal+literal, literal+int-literal, int-literal+literal -> single literal (decimal conversion for the integer); any variable/call/dasham operand -> no fold -> runtime raw addition
representation.no_length_no_header_no_tag: a string is a bare pointer
representation.refinement_to_fixall_report: 'string+int is pointer arithmetic' is true for VARIABLE+int (slice idiom) but incomplete: literal+int folds to concatenation; + is already overloaded by literal-ness; the FIXALL patch is consistent with both halves (folded nodes never reach its check; variable+int stays allowed)
